description:
pkix-ct/src/verify.rs:191-192, 284-285

PKIX-ppbr.5 already filed this from the bug angle. Filing here too
to keep the docs-section count accurate. The two error doc lines
say:

> `Error::SctTimestampOutsideLogWindow` — `sct.timestamp_ms` is
> outside `[log.usable_from_ms, log.retired_at_ms]`.

The implementation in `log_window_contains` (verify.rs:845-857) is
`[lo, hi)`. The function-level doc on `log_window_contains` itself
(verify.rs:837-844) gets this right ("strictly before
retired_at_ms"). The two `# Errors` sections do not.

Recommendation: change `]` to `)` in both `# Errors` sections to
match the implementation. Or fix the implementation per PKIX-ppbr.5
to match the documented `]`.

The `opinion` label is here because PKIX-ppbr.5 is already the
authoritative tracking and a fix there should resolve this. Filed
to keep section counts honest.
title: Doc on verify_sct_for_cert/precert claims [lo, hi] closed window — code is [lo, hi) half-open
